scope: Pre-timing correctness only; untouched remote v2 fixture; no product changes, no timed samples or candidate-specific retries.
observed: smoke-v2 completed four classic SS TCP cells then first official classic SS UDP cell timed out inside udpTransfer. Driver-only first-window reorder and duplicate checks passed; echo server had no panic. Thus this actual failure is not yet attributable to the independently identified persistent-state reuse hazard.

ranked_hypotheses.claim: Initial datagram burst loses a packet before newly created proxy flow is ready
ranked_hypotheses.prediction: Driver sends complete first32-packet train but receiver sees only subset and never sends its aggregate ACK; packet/control trace identifies missing hop.

ranked_hypotheses.claim: Complete upload arrives but reverse aggregate ACK is lost or malformed
ranked_hypotheses.prediction: Echo receives complete unique window and sends17B ACK, but client does not receive corresponding17B ACK.

ranked_hypotheses.claim: Receiver address reuse triggers stale UDP state
ranked_hypotheses.prediction: Echo panics unexpected UDP window on source reuse; existing echo.log has no panic, so this is an independently reachable lifecycle flaw rather than established cause of this timeout.

ranked_hypotheses.claim: Datagram-size or protocol forwarding failure affects transfer packets while64B echoes work
ranked_hypotheses.prediction: 1205B data consistently disappears or truncates at an Xray hop despite successful64B echo; trace identifies differing send/receive byte counts.

next_experiment: One isolated diagnostic run of existing v2 officialclassicUDP cell with syscall-level packet/control traces for application, common client, relay and echo; inspect sent/received sequence/count and ACK stage, not merely rerun success/failure.
